svg.title: DeonHolo's Pac-Man contribution graph
svg.desc: 1,247 contributions and 132 active days in the public rolling-year calendar. Pac-Man must eat the lime power-up before his aura activates. Nearby ghosts fall asleep and later respawn. Respawning inside the active aura immediately puts a ghost back to sleep. The power-up effect expires after eight seconds. Matching Classic, Pixel and Outline casts cycle on successive replays. Updated 2026-11-10 UTC.
